title: High-performance Tree Wrangling, the APL Way // Aaron Hsu // Dyalog '18
summary: Aaron Hsu shows how to manipulate and transform tree data in APL using arrays and inverted tables instead of pointers. He claims much smaller code, better performance and easier parallelisation.
why: HN recommends it as a striking example of high-performance tree handling with array programming.

quote.text: He has one talk (available on YouTube) about his approach to using arrays to working with tree structures in a high-performance way in APL
